message.content: {"question": "The speed of a meteor approaching the Earth is measured as v_i = 100 m/s at a distance of 900 km above sea level. At what speed v_F does this meteor crash on the Earth's surface? (For the Earth: M_E = 5.98 × 10^24 kg, R_E = 6400 km)", "options": {"A": "v_F = 278 km/s", "B": "v_F = 2780 km/s", "C": "v_F = 27.8 km/s", "D": "v_F = 2.78 km/s"}, "correct": null}
